Starting the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. 

The audit revealed a generally well-designed platform with excellent visual consistency, but several critical data quality and rendering issues need attention. 

**Key Findings:**
- **Critical:** Upcoming games are incorrectly appearing in the "Just Happened" section with "FINAL" labels and 0-0 scores.
- **Critical:** Several upcoming KBO baseball games are showing impossible 100% or 0% probabilities.
- **Critical:** The NBA Championship Grid is completely empty, and the Weather page map fails to render.
- **Positive:** The Economics page heatmap and the MLB Championship Grid are standout features that work perfectly.

I have compiled the full findings into the attached markdown report and included screenshots of the key pages and issues discovered.
